id: title:bernatixer:support categorical system one and bound endpoint requests

review.posthog_relevance: Adds bounded HTTP transport parameters and categorical output support for System One, alongside UI help text updates.
review.reason: The change implements bounded HTTP transport with request deadlines and response size limits, and extends System One evaluation support to categorical outputs. This represents a substantive, bounded capability improvement and correctness enhancement. The implementation and relevant checks are visible in the supplied hunks.
